name: Transaction Set Response Trailer
sourceRefs: PyX12 (azoner/pyx12) 999.5010X231.A1.xml. IK502-IK506 are five INDEPENDENT scalar positions all using the same data element (618, Implementation Transaction Set Syntax Error Code) — not a repeating GROUP (X12RepeatDef), since each position stands alone rather than being one of several fields within a repeated group of DIFFERENT field types (contrast CAS's reason/amount/quantity trio, which genuinely is a repeating group). Modeled as 5 plain elements, matching this engine's existing distinction between a repeat group and repeated same-type positions.
